sharedRules.name: Forward Defence
sharedRules.description: This unit can be placed on table in missions with Deep Reserves in addition to the normal limit of one Tank Unit with Front Armour 4 or more, or one Aircraft Unit.

sharedRules.name: Milan Mount
sharedRules.description: Milan missile teams may fire while Mounted as a Passenger in a transport with a Milan Mount, using the Optional Milan missile weapons line.

sharedRules.name: Mountaineers
sharedRules.description: Teams that start their Movement Step adjacent to a cliff or mountain side (or another similar terrain feature) roll a Skill Test. If successful, the Team may move using Terrain Dash across the terrain.
